question: Should the dense facade's internal warmup defaults (what a user gets from Metric::dense() + Adaptation::default()) become {DenseWarmupSeeding::PerTransition, DenseMetricRegularization::Stan, symmetrised precision}? Metric::dense() stays opt-in relative to the diagonal default; no automatic switching is considered.
change_under_test: WarmupConfig::default() dense fields: dense_warmup_seeding Legacy -> PerTransition, dense_metric_regularization MeanVarianceShrinkage -> Stan, dense_symmetrize_precision false -> true (dense adaptive facade only; the diagonal, identity and structured paths do not read these fields)

arms.owalnuts-dense-legacy: Metric::dense() + Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8) + DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION + DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION + DenseWarmupSeeding::Legacy + DenseMetricRegularization::MeanVarianceShrinkage + symmetrised precision off): the current dense defaults stated explicitly (bit-identical to Metric::dense() + Adaptation::default() on the pre-flip library, verified by `funnel selfcheck`, seed 1)
arms.owalnuts-dense-candidate: as owalnuts-dense-legacy but DenseWarmupSeeding::PerTransition + DenseMetricRegularization::Stan + with_dense_symmetrized_precision(true): the candidate defaults

library_commit_for_cells: 3924b090 (main at worktree creation); every arm is stated explicitly so the cells do not depend on library defaults
tuning: Tuning::default(), Init::uniform(), Limits::admit_worst_case(), BridgeStan 2.9.0 ReplicatedStanTarget (models copied from the WP48 sibling build)
seed_check: exact-word git grep over main found no use of 151301-151304; also searched every owalnuts-wt sibling STUDIES tree
order: phase 1: models in listed order, within a model arms owalnuts-diag then owalnuts-dense-candidate, seeds ascending; then the funnel side check (diag seeds ascending, then dense-candidate seeds ascending); then phase 2: owalnuts-dense-legacy over the models in listed order, seeds ascending. Strictly sequential, one cell at a time. Phase 2 is reported but does not enter the decision rule; it runs last so that the decision arms are complete first.
statistic: per cell: minimum over reference parameters of bulk ESS (ArviZ 0.23.4) divided by all target calls including warmup (start search excluded); per model: median over the arm's ok cells; ratio = arm median / diag median; summary = geometric mean of the per-model ratios over models where both arms have at least one ok cell (models excluded for lack of an ok cell are listed; their cells count as gate failures)

funnel.gate: |MCSE z| <= 2 for P(omega < -5) on every seed; a funnel cell that errors or times out fails the gate

decision_rule.statement: Flip the dense facade warmup defaults to {PerTransition, Stan, symmetrised precision} iff ALL of: (1) candidate/diag geomean min-bulk-ESS-per-gradient ratio >= 1.5; (2) candidate gate passes (of 51) >= diag gate passes - 1; (3) candidate funnel |MCSE z| <= 2 on every one of the three seeds; (4) no model passes 3/3 gate cells under diag and 0/3 under the candidate. Timeouts and errors are gate failures; no cell is rerun. Otherwise leave all three as opt-ins, document the negative and recommend nothing.
decision_rule.dense_legacy_role: reported only (what a dense user gets today); not part of the rule

predictions.P3: accel_gp passes 0/3 gate cells in every arm
predictions.P4: candidate total gate passes >= diag total gate passes
predictions.P5: candidate funnel |z| <= 2 on all three seeds AND total candidate retained funnel divergences (3 seeds) <= 2 x total diag retained funnel divergences
predictions.P6: (secondary) legacy/diag geomean <= 0.5 and legacy gate passes < diag gate passes

on_pass: implement the flip in src/walnutpie.rs (WarmupConfig::default dense fields and the enums' #[default]); tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs: record a dense fingerprint if it covers the dense facade, the diagonal default fingerprint must not change; cargo test; CHANGELOG entry naming this study; README section on Metric::dense() for correlated near-Gaussian regressions with the measured ratios, stating that it is never switched on automatically
on_fail: leave the opt-ins, document the negative, recommend nothing
